problem-descriptors.answer: Target users: freelance designers who invoice by hand. Needs and values: get paid on time, spend little time on paperwork. Channels: word of mouth and design communities. Costs: hosting and payment fees. Revenue: a monthly subscription.

goals-and-non-goals.answer: Goal: send an invoice in under two minutes. Non-goals: accounting, payroll, tax filing.

product-map.answer: Spreadsheets meet the need poorly (no reminders). Large accounting suites meet it but cost too much and need training.

constraints.answer: Sector: small business services. Deadline: a first release in three months. Budget: a single maker. Platforms: phone browser first.

open-questions.answer: Which payment providers to support first is undecided.
